15"""GCU400 atan2_ (aten::atan2_, in-place) flat fast path. 

16 

17This shell used to call the stock ``atan2_kernel(A, B, out0=A)`` directly -- generic 

18pointwise_dynamic codegen lowers atan2 to the ``__ef_atan2f`` extern SIP call on this backend 

19(~30x the memory floor under a 48-CTA clamped grid: 2^30 fp16 measured 419ms vs native 12.9ms; 

20after rebuilding the local kernel in 831cb12c8 on 2026-11-13 the core 15-case geomean is 1.133x). 

21This version recasts the kernel body following the same-family second round of 2026-11-16 

22(arctan2.py / atan2.py) and re-sweeps the hyperparameters on the new stack (Triton GCU 4.1.6, TopsRider 20261116): 

23 

24- a K=4 minimax odd polynomial (maxerr 2.3e-5, 1/4 of the fp32 atol 1e-4 gate) replaces K=6, 

25 evaluated in a dtype-dispatched order (HALF: 16-bit Horner / fp32 Estrin); 

26- the inf/inf corner guard folds into a single leading ``minimum(t, 1.0)`` (exploiting GCU min 

27 dropping NaN: the inf/inf ratio NaN collapses to the true ratio 1 -> angle pi/4; finite ratios 

28 are always <= 1, so the normal path is a no-op) -- an inline select would serialize the software 

29 pipeline (4096^2 fp32 probe: 0.68x vs 1.11x); 

30- the negative-y flip becomes a bit-level XOR: ``where(yneg, -a, a)`` loses the -0.0 sign on this 

31 backend (atan2(-0, x>0)/atan2(y<0, +inf) give +0 instead of aten's -0.0, proven by 169 corner 

32 probes on 2026-11-18; the old version had the same defect), while XOR keeps the sign bit and drops a cmp/select; 

33- EVEN predicate-free arm: with N % BLOCK == 0 the ``off < N`` masked load/store is dropped; 

34- hyperparameter re-sweep (new stack, do_bench median w1000/r100): 16-bit 1G 65536/nw1 7.13ms 

35 (8192/nw4 11.86ms), 16.7M 32768/nw1 132us (old 192us); fp32 32768/nw2 (1G 6.3-6.6ms, 16.7M 

36 113us, both better than the old stack's 65536/nw4 sweet spot -- the new stack flips the shape); 

37 131072 fp32 exceeds the DSM 917504B hard limit and is rejected at compile time. 

38 

39Guards and fallbacks: a scalar other is wrapped by an fp32 0-dim factory and takes the fast-path 

40broadcast; inputs beyond the int32 safety domain (numel >= 2^31) or of a non fp16/bf16/fp32 dtype 

41go to the stock wrapper (semantics unchanged); a non-contiguous input is computed on a contiguous 

42copy and written back with copy_; other is materialized per the broadcast rules into a contiguous 

43tensor shaped like input. The in-place aliasing launch is safe (load then store at the same offset 

44per element). Launches retry 3 times for P02 toolchain cold-compile flakes (sinh/rad2deg precedent). 

45""" 

46 

47import logging 

48 

49import torch 

50import triton 

51import triton.language as tl 

52 

53from flag_gems.ops.atan2 import atan2_kernel 

54from flag_gems.runtime import torch_device_fn 

55from flag_gems.utils import libentry 

56 

57logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

58 

59NUM_PROGRAMS = 48 

60 

61# NOTE: module-level constants are referenced from the `_atan2_vec` helper 

62# only. This Triton fork's global-drift check deep-copies captured globals 

63# and compares them with `!=` on every `JITFunction.run`, so a NaN-valued 

64# constexpr referenced directly in a launched kernel body raises 

65# "Global variable _NAN has changed" (constexpr[NaN] != constexpr[NaN]) on 

66# the very first launch. The helper is inlined at compile time and never 

67# launched on its own, so its captured globals stay out of the check. 

68_P0 = tl.constexpr(0.9999693036) 

69_P1 = tl.constexpr(-0.3316778839) 

70_P2 = tl.constexpr(0.1851029694) 

71_P3 = tl.constexpr(-0.09174843878) 

72_P4 = tl.constexpr(0.02377510071) 

73_PI_OVER_2 = tl.constexpr(1.5707963267948966) 

74_PI = tl.constexpr(3.141592653589793) 

75_NAN = tl.constexpr(float("nan")) 

76 

77 

78@triton.jit 

79def _atan2_vec(x, y, HALF: tl.constexpr): 

80 # ATen: atan2(input, other) = math atan2(y=input, x=other). 

81 # Quadrant reduction to [0, pi/2] via min/max, one division, degree-4 

82 # odd minimax polynomial (max abs error 2.3e-5), quadrant fixups with 

83 # bit-level sign tests so -0.0 is handled like the ATen op. 

84 # HALF picks the evaluation order: 16-bit streams are ALU-bound and favor 

85 # the short Horner chain, fp32 favors Estrin (dependency chain 5 -> 3). 

86 ax = tl.abs(x) 

87 ay = tl.abs(y) 

88 mn = tl.minimum(ay, ax) 

89 mx = tl.maximum(ay, ax) 

90 # x == 0 (covers the 0/0 pair) divides by 1, keeping t = 0. inf/inf 

91 # yields a NaN ratio; the trailing minimum maps it back to the true 

92 # ratio 1 (GCU min drops NaN). For finite pairs the correctly-rounded 

93 # ratio never exceeds 1, so the minimum is a no-op there. 

94 t = tl.minimum(mn / tl.where(ax == 0.0, 1.0, mx), 1.0) 

95 if HALF: 

96 s = t * t 

97 p = _P4 

98 p = p * s + _P3 

99 p = p * s + _P2 

100 p = p * s + _P1 

101 p = p * s + _P0 

102 else: 

103 s = t * t 

104 s2 = s * s 

105 e0 = _P0 + s * _P1 

106 e1 = _P2 + s * _P3 

107 p = e0 + s2 * (e1 + s2 * _P4) 

108 a = t * p 

109 a = tl.where(ay > ax, _PI_OVER_2 - a, a) 

110 xi = x.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True) 

111 yi = y.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True) 

112 a = tl.where(xi < 0, _PI - a, a) 

113 # Sign of y via bit-level XOR: `where(yneg, -a, a)` loses the sign of 

114 # -0.0 on this backend (-(+0) folds to +0); the XOR keeps atan2(-0, x>0) 

115 # and atan2(y<0, +inf) at -0.0 exactly like aten. 

116 a = (a.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True) ^ (yi & -2147483648)).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True) 

117 # GCU min/max drop NaN instead of propagating it, so a NaN input 

118 # would come out as a finite ratio; restore the aten NaN result. 

119 a = tl.where((x != x) | (y != y), _NAN, a) 

120 return a 

121 

122 

123@libentry() 

124@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N"]) 

125def _atan2_inplace_kernel( 

126 X, Y, Out, N, HALF: tl.constexpr, EVEN: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr 

127): 

128 # EVEN is set when N % BLOCK == 0: every tile is full, so the `off < N` 

129 # compare and the predicated load/store are dropped (~1-2% at 1G on 

130 # GCU400). Out aliases X (in-place): load and store share offsets. 

131 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

132 num_pids = tl.num_programs(0) 

133 num_blocks = (N + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK 

134 for block_id in tl.range(pid, num_blocks, num_pids): 

135 off = block_id * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

136 if EVEN: 

137 y = tl.load(X + off).to(tl.float32) 

138 x = tl.load(Y + off).to(tl.float32) 

139 else: 

140 mask = off < N 

141 y = tl.load(X + off, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) 

142 x = tl.load(Y + off, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) 

143 res = _atan2_vec(x, y, HALF) 

144 if EVEN: 

145 tl.store(Out + off, res.to(Out.dtype.element_ty)) 

146 else: 

147 tl.store(Out + off, res.to(Out.dtype.element_ty), mask=off < N) 

148 

149 

150def _choose_block(N, itemsize): 

151 # Per-dtype dispatch re-measured on GCU400 with Triton GCU 4.1.6 

152 # (do_bench median, w1000/r100): 

153 # 16-bit 1G: 65536/nw1 7.13ms vs 8192/nw4 11.86ms 

154 # 16-bit 16.7M: 32768/nw1 132µs vs 8192/nw4 192µs (65536/nw1 135µs) 

155 # fp32 1G: 32768/nw2 6.3-6.6ms vs 65536/nw4 6.6-6.8ms 

156 # fp32 16.7M: 32768/nw2 113µs vs 65536/nw4 131µs 

157 # nw2 is pathological on wide 16-bit tiles (1G fp16 10.8ms, 2x worse) 

158 # and 131072 fp32 exceeds the 917504B DSM limit (compile-time reject). 

159 # Tiny N uses a padded power-of-two tile: width-1 vectors are 

160 # pathological on this backend. 

161 if N <= 16384: 

162 return max(128, triton.next_power_of_2(max(N, 1))), 4 

163 if itemsize <= 2: 

164 return (32768, 1) if N <= 2**24 else (65536, 1) 

165 return 32768, 2 

166 

167 

168def _launch_inplace(X, Y, out): 

169 N = X.numel() 

170 if N == 0: 

171 return out 

172 BLOCK, warps = _choose_block(N, X.element_size()) 

173 grid = min(triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK), NUM_PROGRAMS) 

174 # The external llvm converter intermittently fails on cold compiles 

175 # (nondeterministic; observed as converterResult=-2 during host-level 

176 # userland flake windows); retrying the launch recompiles and succeeds. 

177 # 3 attempts keep deterministic breakage loud while riding out the flake 

178 # (sinh.py / rad2deg / atan2_.py precedent). 

179 for attempt in range(3): 

180 try: 

181 with torch_device_fn.device(X.device): 

182 _atan2_inplace_kernel[(grid,)]( 

183 X, 

184 Y, 

185 out, 

186 N, 

187 HALF=X.element_size() <= 2, 

188 BLOCK=BLOCK, 

189 EVEN=N % BLOCK == 0, 

190 num_warps=warps, 

191 ) 

192 return out 

193 except Exception as exc: 

194 if attempt == 2: 

195 raise 

196 logger.warning( 

197 "atan2_ flat kernel launch failed (attempt %d): %s", 

198 attempt + 1, 

199 exc, 

200 ) 

201 

202 

203_FLAT_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32) 

204# Flat 1D indexing computes offsets up to ceil(N / BLOCK) * BLOCK - 1; capping 

205# N at 2**31 - 1 - 65536 keeps the maximum in-tile offset inside int32 for the 

206# largest BLOCK (65536) used by this kernel (copysign_/relu6_ guard). 

207_FLAT_MAX_NUMEL = 2**31 - 1 - 65536 

208 

209 

210def atan2_(input, other): 

211 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME ATAN2_") 

212 if not isinstance(other, torch.Tensor): 

213 # Common pointwise_dynamic has no scalar tier (direct call raises ValueError); wrap the weakly typed 

214 # scalar in an fp32 0-dim factory per aten semantics and take the fast-path broadcast. 

215 other = torch.tensor(other, dtype=torch.float32, device=input.device) 

216 numel = input.numel() 

217 if numel == 0: 

218 return input 

219 if input.dtype not in _FLAT_DTYPES or numel > _FLAT_MAX_NUMEL: 

220 return atan2_kernel(input, other, out0=input) 

221 # aten in-place semantics allow other to broadcast to input's shape; materialize it first as a 

222 # contiguous tensor of the output shape so the flat-index kernel can fetch the matching numerator/denominator in 

223 # output element order. 

224 # Same-shape contiguous inputs take the view-free fast path (host overhead matters for launch-bound small shapes). 

225 if other.shape == input.shape and other.is_contiguous(): 

226 broadcast_other = other 

227 else: 

228 broadcast_other = torch.broadcast_to(other, input.shape) 

229 if not broadcast_other.is_contiguous(): 

230 broadcast_other = broadcast_other.contiguous() 

231 if not input.is_contiguous(): 

232 # Non-contiguous output view: compute on a contiguous copy and write back, avoiding flat kernel linear 

233 # writes corrupting the view layout (same contract already delivered for arctan2_). 

234 contiguous_input = input.contiguous() 

235 _launch_inplace(contiguous_input, broadcast_other, contiguous_input) 

236 input.copy_(contiguous_input) 

237 return input 

238 return _launch_inplace(input, broadcast_other, input)
